title: Nightly 3 a.m. wake-ups and communing

tellings.quote: for the first five years from 19 2015 until 2020, they woke me up religiously every night.

plain: The writer Whitley Strieber says that from 2015 to 2020 the beings he says he is in contact with "woke me up religiously every night" around 3 a.m., and that he spent those hours communing with them. He tells it first hand, linking it to his work The Hidden Garden, as proof of an ongoing bond with visitors he says live among us.
